charge-start.answer: Check the unit’s movement and every restriction still lasting this turn. An exception for one move type does not cancel unrelated charge restrictions.

shooting-after.why: Earlier shooting can enable a later unit’s benefits; check the actual provider and target.

movement-activations.body: Select each eligible unit in turn, including units that Remain Stationary. Resolve its move and immediate effects before selecting another unit. Apply the separate rules for embarked units and arrivals.
